//: Story Phase 10 crew dialogue: the crater and the trail (whose fault it isn't), back aboard (the coin, the king, the pantry), dinner (crying beans, catering), the long night (the galley as a bedroom, the hammock over the captain, Brogath: alleged), the plan, the Grand Feast, the approach, the entry, and inside the storm. Rusty Tom (first to volunteer, sorry every time) and Barnacle Bill (not related).
pete.p10_post: pete[tired]: He's asleep, Captain. Inside a storm. On the floor. Snoring in time with it.
pete.p10_inside_1: pete: We're going ROUND, Captain. In a storm. Made of SHARKS.
pete.p10_inside_2: pete: I've been timing it. We pass the same lobster every forty seconds.
pete.p10_approach: pete[alarmed]: Mind your head, Captain! The ones with the shadow under them are the ones that are coming DOWN.
pete.p10_feast: pete[disgusted]: He wants it PLATED, Captain. Formally. It's beans. You can't plate beans formally. They don't stay where you put them.
pete.p10_plan_1: pete[annoyed]: The Grand Sharkmaster has volunteered to hold nothing. The Grand Sharkmaster ADMINISTRATES.
pete.p10_plan_2: pete: A storm made of wind, and him made of... well. I see the logic, Captain. I hate that I see the logic.
pete.p10_night_1: pete[tired]: (from his sack) Captain. Is he right above you? Directly above?
pete.p10_night_2: pete[annoyed]: (from his sack) 'Brogath the Bashful.' I've written it down, so I can complain about it properly in the morning.
pete.p10_dinner_1: pete[disgusted]: Lobster, Captain. They had LOBSTER. Delivered. We had beans that CRY.
pete.p10_dinner_2: pete[annoyed]: Catering. On a cloud. Paid for with a crown. OUR crown.
pete.p10_aboard_1: pete[annoyed]: A PLASTIC COIN. 'Treasure is about the journey.' It was OUR journey, Captain. It was OUR treasure.
pete.p10_aboard_2: pete[annoyed]: It's got a NAME now. The Bling Bling King. Who gave it a name? Who's out there NAMING things?
pete.p10_isle_1: pete[worried]: Not my fault, Captain. I'd like it in the log. In ink. Underlined.
pete.p10_isle_2: pete[annoyed]: The Grand Sharkmaster reports: our money is flying. That's the whole report. I'm going to sit down.
bob.p10_post: bob[sad]: Night, Captain. Or morning. It's very hard to tell in here.
bob.p10_inside_1: bob: A shark went past the porthole and waved, Captain. With a fin. I waved back. I panicked.
bob.p10_approach: bob[alarmed]: A shark landed on the bucket, Captain! The bucket's GONE! It was a good bucket!
bob.p10_feast: bob: The smoothie looked at me, Captain. It went round, and on the way round it LOOKED at me.
bob.p10_plan: bob: I still think we could board it, Captain. With enough ladders. I'll stop saying it. I'll keep thinking it.
bob.p10_night_1: bob: (from his sack) Captain? Is Brogath real?
captain: Nobody knows, Bob. Nobody's ever checked.
bob: (from his sack) ...He's real to ME.
bob.p10_night_2: bob[happy]: (from his sack) This sack's lumpy. It's lumpy in a friendly way.
bob.p10_dinner_1: bob[happy]: The beans are crying, Captain! On the label! Little tears!
bob: ...Should we be eating something that's crying?
bob.p10_aboard_1: bob: Is it a king now, Captain? It's got a crown. Do we have to bow?
bob.p10_isle: bob[sad]: A pearl necklace went over, Captain. On a shark. It looked lovely on him. I hate that it looked lovely on him.
gristle.p10_post: gristle[concerned]: Go to sleep, Captain. I'll keep an eye on the ropes. And the parrot. And him.
gristle.p10_inside_1: gristle: She's holding, Captain. Every rope I tied. Going round and round, and holding.
gristle.p10_inside_2: gristle[annoyed]: I can't steer, Captain. There's no 'out'. Every way's round.
gristle.p10_approach: gristle: Keep her steady. Watch the marks on the deck. When a shadow comes, MOVE.
gristle.p10_feast: gristle[disgusted]: I'll lash anything you like, Captain. I'm not going in that galley till it's over.
gristle.p10_plan: gristle: Stern to the storm, ship to the wind, him at the rail. It's mad, Captain. It's the right kind of mad.
gristle.p10_night_1: gristle[annoyed]: (from his sack) Nine people, a parrot and a hammock, in a galley. I've counted the snoring. Don't make me say the number.
gristle.p10_night_2: gristle: (from his sack) 'Hierarchy.' He strung it over you, Captain. On purpose. I watched him measure.
gristle.p10_dinner: gristle: Don't let him near the sauce, Captain. I've read the can. The can's frightened.
gristle.p10_aboard: gristle[annoyed]: Look at her. Rigging like knitting. Sail like a hanky. I'll get her sailing, Captain. I won't get her pretty.
gristle.p10_isle: gristle[annoyed]: Twenty-seven coins and a bent spoon. Seven floors, Captain. SEVEN floors, for a bent spoon.
jim.p10_post: jim[sad]: I'll make breakfast. If there's a morning. In here. Beans.
jim.p10_inside: jim[sad]: Every can in the galley's rolled to the low side, Captain. Then the low side moves.
jim.p10_approach: jim[alarmed]: The pots are in, the stove's out, the sauce is under a blanket. If anything gets out of that galley, it's not my fault.
jim.p10_feast_1: jim[angry]: A fork, Captain. In a blender. I'm not saying it again.
jim.p10_feast_2: jim: Five parts. Any order. And then he wants it PLATED, like it's a wedding.
jim.p10_plan: jim: If it's charging he needs, Captain, I've got beans. I've ALWAYS got beans. That's the problem.
jim.p10_night_1: jim[annoyed]: (from his sack) I'm sleeping next to my own stove, Captain. It's warm. That's the only good thing I'm going to say.
jim.p10_dinner_1: jim: Not a Grand Galley Grand Chef, Captain. A cook. Jim. I'll take the help, not the title.
jim.p10_dinner_2: jim[disgusted]: 'Contains Real Tears.' I don't want to know whose.
jim.p10_aboard_1: jim: About the pantry, Captain. Before you look in it. Whatever you're imagining, it's beans.
jim.p10_isle: jim[sad]: I was going to buy a kitchen, Captain. A whole kitchen. With a door.
ned.p10_post: ned: I'll take the watch, Captain. Not that there's anything to watch but sharks.
ned.p10_inside: ned: I can see the middle, Captain. Out the hatch. It's calm in the middle. It's the only calm thing for a mile.
ned.p10_approach: ned: Final approach. I'll call the distance. Don't look up.
ned.p10_feast: ned: He's glowing, Captain. Or the lamp's on him. Either way I'm standing back.
ned.p10_plan: ned: I said wait. I was wrong. I'll hold the course you give me, Captain, all the way in.
ned.p10_night_1: ned: (from his sack) I keep watching the hatch, Captain. Something keeps coming down it.
ned.p10_dinner: ned: There's a barge on that cloud, Captain. With a table on it. I'm not making that up.
ned.p10_aboard: ned: It came up under the bow like it owned her. Chain on. Crown on. Didn't say a word.
ned.p10_isle: ned: It's up there, Captain. All of it. Going round. You can see a crown flash every time it comes past.
hale.p10_inside: hale: Log entry, Captain: 'Inside the storm.' I don't know what else to put. I've left a space.
hale.p10_approach: hale: The cannons are lashed, Captain. All four. Even the bean ones.
hale.p10_plan: hale: Four cannons, two full of beans. I'd still like it noted that I offered.
hale.p10_night: hale: On watch, Captain. Log entry: 'The hands asleep under the spare sail. Storm still following. Nobody surprised.'
nell.p10_inside: nell: We're going round with the wind, Captain. It's the only way the wind goes in here.
nell.p10_approach: nell: Wind's dead behind us, Captain. If he goes off now, we'll fly.
sully.p10_inside: sully: Holding on, Captain. It's my new job.
sully.p10_approach: sully: Hauling, Captain. Everything that'll haul.
fennimore.p10_inside: fennimore: As a doctor, Captain: everyone's dizzy. As a doctor, so am I.
fennimore.p10_approach: fennimore: Bandages ready, Captain. I've a feeling.
wick.p10_inside: wick: I've been sick twice, Captain. Once for the storm. Once for the smell.
wick.p10_night: wick: (asleep, under the sail) ...hammock... I had a hammock...
rook.p10_inside: rook: I can't count the planks, Captain. They keep going round.
rook.p10_night: rook: (asleep, under the sail) ...no planks... just sky...
brask.p10_inside: brask: Fired the wrong way. I'd lose my rating for that, Captain. He gets a sash.
brask.p10_night: brask: (asleep, under the sail) ...fire in the hole...
jory.p10_inside: jory: Captain. It's the same night. Isn't it? It's still the same night.
jory.p10_night: jory: (asleep, under the sail, very quietly) ...no cash value...
finch.p10_inside: finch: Forty years at sea, Captain. First time inside the weather.
finch.p10_night: finch: (asleep, under the sail) ...wrong way... wrong way...
mags.p10_inside: mags: My grog's sloshing round the mug. Round and round. Like everything.
quill.p10_inside: quill: Inventory, Captain: one ship, one storm, us inside it. I'll do the rest later.
quill.p10_night: quill: (asleep, under the sail) ...one pillow, communal...
penhallow.p10_inside: penhallow: Is there tea, Captain? There isn't tea. There's never going to be tea.
garrick.p10_inside_1: garrick[proud]: Technically, Captain, we're IN the storm. Which is very close to having stopped it.
garrick.p10_inside_2: garrick[businesslike]: The nap can wait. I've said it out loud. It's binding.
garrick.p10_approach_1: garrick[nervous]: <k>gloooorp</> ...That's the charge settling, Captain. Perfectly normal. Five hundred times normal, if anything.
garrick.p10_approach_2: garrick[proud]: The ONE TIME, Captain. I can feel it. Here. And here. And, regrettably, here.
garrick.p10_feast_1: garrick[proud]: Every part, Captain. In order. Then plated. A Grand Stenchmaster doesn't charge off a SAUCER.
garrick.p10_plan_1: garrick[proud]: Meet wind with wind, Captain. Rumpold Windbreaker the Resolute. It's all in the book. Allegedly. Definitely. In the book.
garrick.p10_plan_2: garrick[businesslike]: I'll need charging, of course. Fifty times standard output. Fifty-two, conservatively. Fifty-three if the beans are fresh.
garrick.p10_night_1: garrick[proud]: (from the hammock) Hierarchy, Captain. Not personal. Structural.
garrick.p10_night_2: garrick[proud]: (from the hammock) The Grand Stenchmasters of old all slept elevated. It's in the literature. Volume One.
garrick.p10_dinner_1: garrick[proud]: Spicy Stench Sauce, Captain. From the same establishment as my sash. A reputable supplier. Very loyal customer base.
garrick.p10_dinner_2: garrick[offended]: A WHOLE can is the correct amount. The can says 'serves one'. I am one.
garrick.p10_aboard_1: garrick[proud]: A participation prize, Captain! We PARTICIPATED. Magnificently.
garrick.p10_aboard_2: garrick[businesslike]: The Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Celebration Feast is already named. The food is a detail.
garrick.p10_isle_1: garrick[proud]: A direct hit, Captain. Upwards. The treasure was LIBERATED. It's simply... very high up.
garrick.p10_isle_2: garrick[businesslike]: Those coins have had direct-blast exposure, Captain. A second-layer bouquet. Collectors pay extra for that.
rusty_tom.p10_post: rusty_tom: Night, Captain. I'll check on him if he stops snoring. Somebody has to.
rusty_tom.p10_inside: rusty_tom: I let go of the sash, Captain. Eventually. My hands are still holding it in my head.
rusty_tom.p10_entry: rusty_tom: HOLD THE SASH! ...NO! LET GO OF THE SASH!
rusty_tom.p10_approach: rusty_tom: On his left, Captain. Holding the sash. Not looking down. Not breathing in.
rusty_tom.p10_feast: rusty_tom: Short straw, Captain. I'm not surprised. I've had that kind of week. I've had that kind of LIFE.
rusty_tom.p10_plan: rusty_tom: First to volunteer, Captain. Always. Sorry every time. But first.
rusty_tom.p10_night_1: rusty_tom[sad]: (from his sack) I can still smell it, Captain. The old quarters. In my eyebrows. I haven't got eyebrows any more.
rusty_tom.p10_night_2: rusty_tom: (from his sack) Is the Grand Stenchmaster always like this at bedtime, Captain?
rusty_tom.p10_dinner: rusty_tom: I'll eat anything, Captain. I'm not saying I'll keep it down. I'll eat it.
rusty_tom.p10_aboard_1: rusty_tom: Rusty Tom, Captain. Deckhand. Since Portsmouth. You've walked past me a lot. It's all right. Everybody does.
barnacle_bill.p10_approach: barnacle_bill: Right side. Holding. Don't talk to me.
barnacle_bill.p10_night_1: barnacle_bill: (from his sack, round the pipe) Hierarchy.
Barnacle Bill shakes his head, slowly, once, and closes his eyes.
